title: Beyond templates: exploring uncharted territory in anisotropic gold nanostructure-oligomer composites synthesis and electrocatalytic performance towards environmental pollutants
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,40234-40246
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07744J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Veeramani Mangala Gowri, Theelada Panleam, Jayant Giri, Nattapong Srithongkul, Krishnamoorthy Shanmugaraj, Amanullah Fatehmulla, Sirikanjana Thongmee
The synthesis and electrocatalytic activity of oligo 3-amino-5-mercapto-1,2,4-triazole (oligo AMTa) based gold nanostructures (AuNS) with excellent colloidal stability is demonstrated via a simple, adaptable and template-free technique.
